intro_html: A big pot of hearty beef chili, spooned over rice and topped with melty cheddar. This is cold-weather comfort that meal-preps like a champion, gets better on day two, and still brings 37 grams of protein a bowl. Make a batch on Sunday and lunch is handled all week.
cost_closing_html: About $3.22 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a filling, protein-packed chili that tastes like it took all day.
portion_html: Weigh the rice and the chili together, subtract the empty-pot weight from Step 1, and divide the total by 14. Scoop equal amounts into each container. Every bowl lands near 477 calories and 37 grams of protein.
upsell_html: Hearty dinners for about $3.22 a bowl (at everyday cost). This is one of many. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons, calculators, and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Beef on sale, frozen, wins again. This is the ingredient that drives the cost, so buy it low and freeze it.
Tomato paste is pennies and it deepens the whole pot. Freeze leftover paste in tablespoon dollops for next time.
Canned beans and corn by the case shave a little off each can and you will reach for them again next week.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cook the rice. Three and a half cups dry jasmine with water per the package, then set aside.
Brown the ground beef in a large pot over medium-high heat, breaking it up. Drain any excess.
Stir in the tomato paste and taco seasoning and cook for a minute to bloom the flavor.
Add the drained beans, corn, and beef broth. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes until it thickens into a chili.
Serve each bowl over rice and top with the shredded cheddar.

head.description: A hearty ground beef and black bean chili over rice with cheddar. Fourteen servings at about 477 calories and 37 grams of protein for roughly $3.22 each (at everyday cost).

recipeIngredient: 2 cans, drained Sweet Whole Kernel Corn
steps: Cook 3.5 cups dry jasmine rice per the package and set aside.
Brown the ground beef in a large pot and drain any excess.
Stir in tomato paste and taco seasoning and cook 1 minute.
Add beans, corn, and beef broth and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve over rice and top with cheddar.
Weigh the batch and divide into 14 containers.
